'''Leslie Burns''' was one of Decipher's studio artists on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]].<ref name="jkartists">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/artists/index.html Jedi Knights: Artists], decipher.com (2000). Lists "Decipher's studio artists". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001207231800/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/artists/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref> [[Leesub Sirlin]] is an anagram of the name.
